doc.title: Intake rota: what changes in November

segments.exact: The intake rota moves from weekly to fortnightly in November.

circumstance.context: Intake rota: what changes in November

segments.exact: Weekly hand-offs lost more context than they saved: every hand-off restarted the open cases from the summary sheet.

circumstance.context: Intake rota: what changes in November

segments.exact: Fortnightly hand-offs with a fifteen-minute overlap call keep each case with one owner long enough to close it.

circumstance.context: Intake rota: what changes in November

segments.exact: The summary sheet stays, but it is written at the end of a rota rather than the start.
